
ADD-ASSUMPTION
Add an assumption to a work unit during specification

WHEN TO USE
  Use to document assumptions made during specification that may need validation later.

USAGE
  fspec add-assumption <workUnitId> <assumption>

ARGUMENTS
  <workUnitId> (required)
    Work unit ID
  <assumption> (required)
    Assumption text

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Add assumption
  $ fspec add-assumption AUTH-001 "Users have valid email addresses"
  ✓ Assumption added successfully

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-rule
  fspec add-question
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec remove-assumption
  fspec restore-assumption
